title: Family Friendly Business Directory - NM Family Friendly Business

facts.fact: Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming began serving pets and pet parents in July 2022, according to its directory listing.
facts.quote: Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming is based in Albuquerque, NM, and began serving pets and pet parents in July 2022.

facts.fact: Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming says its founders started as mobile pet grooming clients in 2016, before founding the company.
facts.quote: we started as mobile pet grooming clients in 2016 and loved the convenience and quality.

facts.fact: Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming states it serves the greater Albuquerque and Rio Rancho areas.
facts.quote: to serve the growing need for mobile pet grooming services in the greater Albuquerque and Rio Rancho areas.

facts.fact: Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming describes itself as locally owned and operated.
Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming's listed phone number is (505) 633-4300.
Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming's listed website is wetpaws.pet.
Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming's listed mailing address is PO Box 51864 in Albuquerque, Bernalillo, NM 87181-1864.
Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming offers online scheduling, e-mail/text reminders, card-on-file payment, and electronic forms with e-signature.
facts.quote: With online scheduling, e-mail/text reminders, the ability to keep a payment card on file, and electronic forms with e-signature

facts.fact: The directory entry for Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming is listed at the Silver level, with the listing shown for the years 2026, 2025, and 2024.
